review_points.title: Organizational AI activity
review_points.prompt: Which best describes the NSO's current or planned use of AI for statistical production or dissemination?
options: No current or planned activity
Planning or early exploration
Active development or piloting
Production use
review_points.note: G1 is not scored. It is used to interpret and route the scored questions.

review_points.title: Staff use of AI tools
review_points.prompt: Which best describes staff use of AI tools in the NSO, whether tools are officially provided or not? Consider both use for statistical work and general productivity. Answer both parts.
review_points.source_anchor: ### G2. Staff use of AI tools
review_points.note: G2 is not scored. Report both parts as an adoption and governance profile alongside the readiness profile.

parts.label: Part A: Use pattern
options: No known staff use
Personal or otherwise unapproved tools are used, but no enterprise-provided tools are used
Enterprise-provided tools are used, but personal or otherwise unapproved use is not known
Both enterprise-provided and personal or otherwise unapproved tools are used

parts.label: Part B: Governance of use
options: No known guidance or governance
Informal or limited guidance exists
Formal guidance has been communicated to relevant staff
Use is managed and monitored under formal controls
Unknown

review_points.title: Formal AI strategy
review_points.prompt: To what extent has the NSO adopted a formal AI strategy for statistical work?
options: Not in place: No formal AI strategy exists.
Early or partial: AI strategy discussions are underway or a draft exists.
Established: A formal AI strategy has been adopted.
Advanced or systematic: A formal strategy is adopted, implemented, and monitored.

review_points.title: AI-specific legal and privacy guidance
review_points.prompt: To what extent does the NSO have formal AI-specific legal and privacy guidance that relevant staff know about and can follow?
options: Not in place: No AI-specific legal or privacy guidance exists.
Early or partial: Guidance is informal, partial, or available only for some activities.
Established: Formal guidance exists, but staff awareness or application is uneven.
Advanced or systematic: Formal guidance is known, followed, and reviewed.
review_points.source_anchor: ### Q2. AI-specific legal and privacy guidance

review_points.title: AI-literacy training and guidance
review_points.prompt: What AI-literacy training or guidance has the NSO provided to staff?
options: Not in place: No organizational AI-literacy guidance or training has been provided.
Early or partial: Informal or occasional awareness activities have been provided.
Established: Structured training has been provided to selected staff or relevant groups.
Advanced or systematic: Structured training is provided systematically across relevant staff and is maintained over time.

review_points.title: Specialized in-house expertise
review_points.prompt: To what extent does the NSO have specialized AI expertise in-house to develop, assess, and maintain AI systems?
options: Not in place: No specialized AI expertise is available in-house.
Early or partial: A few individuals have relevant skills, but coverage is limited and concentrated.
Established: In-house expertise covers some important technical areas or projects, with material gaps remaining.
Advanced or systematic: An in-house team covers the main AI lifecycle needs, including development, assessment, deployment, and maintenance.

review_points.title: Current technical capacity
review_points.prompt: What is the NSO's current technical capacity to support AI-related work?
options: Not in place: Basic infrastructure is unreliable, including frequent electricity or internet disruption.
Early or partial: Infrastructure is reliable enough for experimentation but is limited for operational use.
Established: Secure infrastructure supports operational AI development, with some deployment or monitoring capability.
Advanced or systematic: Secure end-to-end capacity supports deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and controlled scaling.

review_points.title: Funding and resources
review_points.prompt: What best describes funding for the NSO's current or planned AI activities?
options: Not in place: No funding is available.
Early or partial: Some ad-hoc funding is available.
Established: Funding is available for an approved AI pilot.
Advanced or systematic: Sustained funding covers the full lifecycle, including operation, maintenance, and monitoring.
Not applicable: The NSO has no current or planned AI activity.

review_points.title: AI-specific partnerships
review_points.prompt: To what extent does the NSO have AI-specific partnerships that provide access to expertise, methods, technology, implementation support, or responsible-AI advice? Do not count ordinary statistical partnerships.
options: Not in place: No relevant AI-specific partnership exists.
Early or partial: Informal or occasional AI-specific support is available.
Established: Active partnerships provide recurring access to AI capability.
Advanced or systematic: Governed partnerships build sustained institutional capability and transfer knowledge to the NSO.

review_points.title: Product reference for Q8-Q11
review_points.prompt: Name one suitable key public data product: ________________________________

review_points.title: Metadata standards and classifications
review_points.prompt: For the selected product, how is metadata documented and structured?
options: Not in place: Little or no metadata is available.
Early or partial: Metadata is mainly human-readable or produced ad hoc.
Established: Recognized metadata standards are used for some or key parts of the product.
Advanced or systematic: Maintained, machine-readable, standardized metadata covers the product.
Unknown

review_points.title: Quality control and provenance
review_points.prompt: For the selected product, how are quality, provenance, revisions, and known limitations documented and communicated?
options: Not in place: These matters are not documented systematically.
Early or partial: Some narrative or partial documentation is available.
Established: Systematic documentation is maintained for the product.
Advanced or systematic: Structured, machine-readable quality and provenance information is linked to the product.
Unknown

review_points.title: Searchable data catalogue
review_points.prompt: How can users discover the selected product?
options: Not in place: There is no central inventory or reliable discovery route.
Early or partial: Users rely on static webpages, publication lists, or basic search.
Established: A maintained catalogue supports structured search or filtering.
Advanced or systematic: A comprehensive, machine-accessible catalogue is the authoritative discovery route.
Unknown

review_points.title: API access
review_points.prompt: How can users access the selected product programmatically?
options: Not in place: No API is available.
Early or partial: A pilot or limited API exists.
Established: An API covers the selected product.
Advanced or systematic: A documented and reliable API provides the product and relevant metadata.
Unknown

review_points.title: Agentic AI access and GenAI dissemination
review_points.prompt: To what extent is the NSO using or preparing for AI-mediated dissemination or access by AI agents, with appropriate safeguards?
options: Not in place: A current or planned relevant activity exists, but no AI-mediated access or dissemination capability or safeguards are in place.
Early or partial: Awareness, discussion, or early exploration is underway.
Established: An AI-mediated dissemination or agent-access pilot is underway.
Advanced or systematic: Governed production use includes monitoring and human oversight.
Not applicable: There is no current or planned activity relevant to this question.
Unknown
review_points.source_anchor: ### Q12. Agentic AI access and GenAI dissemination

review_points.title: Optional Evidence
review_points.prompt: Where convenient, respondents may provide a public URL or document reference for a strategy, guidance, training program, product catalogue, API, or license. Evidence links are optional and do not affect the response score directly.
